title: Plan document
description: Validates a plan document after check_schemas.py has converted it to {front_matter, sections}: front_matter is the parsed YAML front matter, sections is the list of level-2 heading texts in document order. A plan document states what will be built to meet one or more requirements, what is in and out of scope, and the phases the work divides into, each small enough for one session. The schema checks that each section exists, not what it says; other level-2 sections are allowed.
